transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Hi. It's nice to meet you too. Well, I suppose occupational health sent me. I've gotten into this pattern lately where I just push breakfast and lunch aside, usually when I'm busy with long lab runs or exhibition work. And then by the time I actually do eat, I make sure to keep it to something very small and controlled. So, they wanted me to come in and talk to someone about it.
Are you afraid of gaining weight?
Yes. Honestly, if the scale goes up even a fraction, I feel this... this sharp panic. It just makes me feel like I’m losing the discipline I’ve worked so hard to maintain.
Is your weight currently lower than what doctors have told you is healthy for your height?

Yes, it is. I mean, my clothes are definitely looser, and the numbers on the scale have just kept drifting down lately. But... honestly, part of me sees that as a sign that I'm staying focused. It feels like proof that I'm not letting all the chaos at work spill over into my body.
Do you feel fat even though other people tell you that you are too thin?

Yes, I do. I know people say that, but when I look in the mirror before heading to the lab, I really don't see someone who is thin. I mostly just notice my stomach or my hips. To me, it just feels like... like those areas make me look careless, or unserious.
No, they haven't stopped. I mean, they might be a little lighter lately, but... no, I still get them every month.
Do you ever have episodes where you eat an unusually large amount of food in a short period of time?
No, I don't. I... I really don't lose control like that. My meals are always pretty structured and kept very small. So, no, I haven't ever had an episode where I eat a large amount of food at once.
Were you at a normal weight before this pattern of restricting your eating began?

I'm... I'm not really sure. I don't exactly know what my weight was before I started being more careful. It feels like I've just... always paid attention to my meals to some degree. So I don't really have a clear 'before' picture or a specific starting weight to give you.
Before this pattern of restricting your eating began, had your weight ever been in the normal range for your height?

Like I just mentioned... I really don't know. I couldn't tell you if it was ever technically in the normal range for my height. It feels like I've just always monitored what I eat, for as long as I can remember. So... no, I really don't have a baseline weight to give you where things were different.
How old were you when this pattern of restricting your eating and being underweight first began?

I can't really give you an exact age. Like I was saying a minute ago, it just feels like I've always been this way. I... I don't remember a specific time or a certain year when I started being so careful about my food, or when my weight first dropped. It's just been a part of my routine for as long as I can remember, so I can't really pinpoint when it all began.
